Container.Name: CineSets
Container.Overview: Automatic, beautiful collections for Emby, Jellyfin and Silo: trending, streaming, genre, best of, kids and seasonal collections and movie franchises from what's already in your library, each with a matching poster, kept updated on a schedule. It only ever touches collections it made itself. Before the first start, run setup once in Unraid's terminal, which asks for your server's LAN address and API key: docker run --rm -it -e PUID=99 -e PGID=100 -v /mnt/user/appdata/cinesets:/config ghcr.io/blurbery/cinesets:1 setup. The same command with logos in place of setup downloads the streaming logos. Then start the container: it makes the collections and keeps them updated on the schedule in config.yml. The setup guide has the rest: https://github.com/blurbery/cinesets/blob/main/docs/setup.md
Container.Requires: An Emby, Jellyfin or Silo server and an API key from it, made by an administrator. Run setup once before the first start (see the overview).

Config.Name: Config and data
Config.Description: config.yml, CineSets' records, posters and logos. Keep it: it's how CineSets knows which collections are its own.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: CineSets runs as this user, never root (99 is Unraid's nobody). The config folder is handed to it.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: CineSets runs as this group (100 is Unraid's users).
